propositions: bridge_project and repos fields must be added to ticket state schema, seeded in make_initial_state, and projected by reducer on both CREATE and EDIT events
bridge_project is tri-state (absent for legacy, empty string for never-sync, key for sync) and promote-only; changing it on an already-bound ticket must be rejected with no state change
Create-time arguments --bridge-project and --repos must be added to all three write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) and produce identical ticket state
The absent, explicit-empty, and set states of bridge_project must be distinguishable after full replay to prevent false "unsynced" interpretation
repos is freely editable post-create and never reaches the tracker, while bridge_project edit is guarded by binding presence via bindings.json reader
Tickets created before this change must replay to identical state except for the two new keys
